metadata.note: Illustrative data for the fictional Aurelia Hotel public demo.

property.name: Aurelia Hotel
property.description: A fictional city hotel for restful short stays and longer visits.
property.wifi: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.
property.parking: On-site parking is available for $18 per night.
property.accessibility: Accessible rooms and step-free public access are available on request.
property.luggage: Complimentary luggage storage is available before check-in and after check-out.
property.pool: Yes. The heated indoor pool is open 6:00 AM–10:00 PM.
property.breakfast: Breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM–10:30 AM in the Garden Room. It is included with Aurelia Suite stays; other room rates do not include it.

policies.children: Children are welcome; the Family Room is designed for families and small groups.
policies.pets: Pets are not specified in this demo hotel information.
policies.early_check_in: Early check-in is subject to demo availability and is not guaranteed.
policies.late_checkout: Late check-out is subject to demo availability and is not guaranteed.
policies.cancellation: Demo cancellation policy: cancel by 6:00 PM local hotel time one day before check-in for no cancellation charge. Later cancellations are charged one night's illustrative room rate.
policies.extra_bed: Extra beds are not specified. Room capacity must not be exceeded.
policies.payment: Accepted payment methods are Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and cash. A photo ID is required at check-in.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: A comfortable, efficient room for short city stays.
rooms.notable_differences: The most economical room; it has a work desk but no view or bathtub.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: A brighter room with more space and a city view.
rooms.notable_differences: More space and a city view than the Standard Room.

rooms.name: Premium Room
rooms.description: A quiet, spacious room with upgraded amenities and a garden outlook.
rooms.notable_differences: The quiet-room choice, with a garden view and soaking tub.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: A flexible room designed for families and small groups.
rooms.notable_differences: The largest-capacity option, with two bathrooms and flexible family bedding.

rooms.name: Aurelia Suite
rooms.description: Our most spacious suite with a separate sitting area.
rooms.notable_differences: The only room with included breakfast and a separate lounge.

faqs.pool: Yes. The heated indoor pool is open 6:00 AM–10:00 PM.
faqs.breakfast: Breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM–10:30 AM in the Garden Room.
faqs.parking: On-site parking is available for $18 per night.
faqs.wifi: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.
faqs.luggage: Complimentary luggage storage is available before check-in and after check-out.
faqs.accessibility: Accessible rooms and step-free public access are available on request.
